prompts.title: Full UI / UX Audit
prompts.summary: Diagnose an entire screen before you start redesigning it.

prompts.title: Single-Screen Friction Audit
prompts.summary: Find the exact places where one user flow becomes confusing or slow.

prompts.title: Feature-to-UI Fit Review
prompts.summary: Check whether a feature deserves its current amount of screen space and visual emphasis.

prompts.title: Consistency Audit
prompts.summary: Find places where the app looks like multiple design systems were combined.

prompts.title: Before/After Change Review
prompts.summary: Check whether a recent UI change actually improved the experience.

prompts.title: Primary Action Cleanup
prompts.summary: Make the main action on a screen obvious without making everything else disappear.

prompts.title: Spacing Cleanup
prompts.summary: Standardize awkward gaps, padding, and alignment.

prompts.title: Information Density Reduction
prompts.summary: Reduce clutter without making the screen less useful.

prompts.title: Card Overuse Cleanup
prompts.summary: Stop every section from becoming its own rounded card.

prompts.title: Navigation Structure Review
prompts.summary: Check whether the app’s navigation matches how users think about the product.

prompts.title: Bottom Tab Bar Cleanup
prompts.summary: Make a mobile bottom tab bar clearer and less crowded.

prompts.title: Settings Reorganization
prompts.summary: Turn a long settings page into a predictable structure.

prompts.title: Back / Close / Cancel Behavior Review
prompts.summary: Make modal and nested-screen exits predictable.

prompts.title: Mobile-First Screen Review
prompts.summary: Redesign a screen for actual phone use instead of squeezing the desktop layout.

prompts.title: Keyboard + Form Mobile Review
prompts.summary: Prevent the software keyboard from blocking fields, buttons, and feedback.

prompts.title: Modal / Sheet Review
prompts.summary: Choose between modal, sheet, inline expansion, or full screen on mobile.

prompts.title: Small-Screen Overflow Audit
prompts.summary: Find everything that clips, overflows, or requires sideways scrolling.

prompts.title: Touch Target Review
prompts.summary: Make interactive controls comfortable to tap without making the UI bulky.

prompts.title: Color System Audit
prompts.summary: Turn random hex values into a small, reusable color system.

prompts.title: Typography Hierarchy Audit
prompts.summary: Create a clear text hierarchy without using dozens of sizes and weights.

prompts.title: Dark Mode Review
prompts.summary: Make dark mode readable and intentional instead of just inverted.

prompts.title: Visual Tone Alignment
prompts.summary: Make the interface match a desired product personality without copying another app.

prompts.title: Button System Cleanup
prompts.summary: Standardize buttons by purpose instead of creating a new style for every feature.

prompts.title: Input / Form Component System
prompts.summary: Standardize text fields, selects, toggles, checkboxes, and validation feedback.

prompts.title: Modal System Review
prompts.summary: Reduce a collection of inconsistent dialogs into a small set of patterns.

prompts.title: Icon Consistency Review
prompts.summary: Make icons feel like one family and remain understandable.

prompts.title: Login Screen Review
prompts.summary: Make login feel trustworthy, clear, and fast.

prompts.title: Signup Flow Simplification
prompts.summary: Reduce signup friction while keeping required information.

prompts.title: Validation Message Rewrite
prompts.summary: Turn vague or technical form errors into useful instructions.

prompts.title: Permission / Access Denied UX
prompts.summary: Handle unauthorized actions without confusing users or leaking sensitive information.

prompts.title: First-Run Onboarding Audit
prompts.summary: Make the first experience teach the product without turning into a slideshow.

prompts.title: Empty New Account Experience
prompts.summary: Make a brand-new account feel useful even before the user has data.

prompts.title: Feature Introduction Without Pop-up Spam
prompts.summary: Teach newly released features without interrupting the whole app.

prompts.title: Empty State Design
prompts.summary: Turn “nothing here” into useful guidance.

prompts.title: Loading State Review
prompts.summary: Make waiting feel stable and informative without fake progress.

prompts.title: Error State System
prompts.summary: Create consistent errors for recoverable, blocking, and offline failures.

prompts.title: Success / Confirmation Review
prompts.summary: Confirm completed actions without overusing popups and toasts.

prompts.title: Dashboard Priority Audit
prompts.summary: Make a dashboard answer the most important questions first.

prompts.title: Metric Card Cleanup
prompts.summary: Standardize metric cards and make numbers understandable.

prompts.title: Table-to-Mobile Transformation
prompts.summary: Make a data table usable on a phone without hiding essential information.

prompts.title: Filter / Sort UX Review
prompts.summary: Simplify filters and sorting so users can predict the result.

prompts.title: Accessibility Baseline Audit
prompts.summary: Catch common accessibility problems before launch.

prompts.title: Keyboard Navigation Review
prompts.summary: Make a web interface usable without a mouse.

prompts.title: Motion / Animation Restraint Review
prompts.summary: Keep animation useful and comfortable.

prompts.title: Readable Copy + Contrast Review
prompts.summary: Make important text readable under real conditions.

prompts.title: AI-Generated UI Cleanup
prompts.summary: Remove common visual patterns that make an app feel auto-generated.

prompts.title: Humanize Interface Copy
prompts.summary: Rewrite UI text so it sounds natural, concise, and specific.

prompts.title: Remove Redundant Explanations
prompts.summary: Find copy that repeats what the UI already communicates.

prompts.title: Notification Copy Review
prompts.summary: Make push/in-app notifications useful instead of noisy.

prompts.title: Regression Review After UI Changes
prompts.summary: Check that visual improvements did not break behavior.

prompts.title: Final Visual Polish Pass
prompts.summary: Catch small inconsistencies after the structure is already correct.

prompts.title: Real-Task QA Script
prompts.summary: Test the interface by completing the actual user task end to end.

prompts.title: Cross-Screen Consistency Pass
prompts.summary: Check whether the finished app feels like one product.

prompts.title: Stop-Redesigning Check
prompts.summary: Decide whether further visual changes are actually necessary.

prompts.title: Search Experience Audit
prompts.summary: Make search predictable, fast to understand, and useful even when the first query fails.

prompts.title: Search Results Hierarchy
prompts.summary: Make result lists scannable so users can distinguish the right item quickly.

prompts.title: Global Search / Command Menu Review
prompts.summary: Design a fast cross-app search or command surface without making it a junk drawer.

prompts.title: No-Results Recovery
prompts.summary: Turn zero search results into a useful next step.

prompts.title: Invite Flow Review
prompts.summary: Make inviting another person understandable from start to finish.

prompts.title: Presence / Live Activity Review
prompts.summary: Show who is active without making the interface noisy or invasive.

prompts.title: Activity Feed Cleanup
prompts.summary: Make recent activity useful instead of turning it into notification spam.

prompts.title: Roles & Permissions UX
prompts.summary: Explain access levels so users understand what they can do and why.

prompts.title: Upgrade Screen Review
prompts.summary: Make a premium or upgrade screen clear without turning it into a pressure page.

prompts.title: Pricing Comparison Cleanup
prompts.summary: Make plan differences easy to compare without overwhelming users.

prompts.title: Trial / Paywall Ethics Review
prompts.summary: Check that monetization is persuasive without using dark patterns.

prompts.title: Billing Settings Review
prompts.summary: Make subscription and purchase management easy to understand.

prompts.title: Long-Text Resilience Review
prompts.summary: Make layouts survive longer labels, names, translations, and user-generated text.

prompts.title: Date / Time / Number Formatting Review
prompts.summary: Make regional formats understandable and consistent.

prompts.title: Dynamic Content Stress Test
prompts.summary: Test interfaces with missing, unusually long, zero, huge, and unexpected values.

prompts.title: Permission Request UX
prompts.summary: Ask for device or account permissions at the moment they make sense.

prompts.title: Delete / Export Data Flow
prompts.summary: Make account deletion and data export clear, deliberate, and recoverable where appropriate.

prompts.title: Sensitive Action Confirmation
prompts.summary: Design confirmation for actions that can cause real loss or exposure.

prompts.title: Microinteraction Feedback Review
prompts.summary: Make taps, saves, toggles, and state changes feel responsive without decoration overload.

prompts.title: Animation Timing Audit
prompts.summary: Standardize transition timing so the app feels coherent and fast.

prompts.title: Sound / Haptic Feedback Plan
prompts.summary: Use sound and haptics only where they add meaning.
